Senior Financial Analyst (Confidential Search)

Our client, a well-known healthcare network in the Denver area, is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join its FP&A team. The employer is confidential at this stage; we will share the name with shortlisted candidates before any interview.

Responsibilities
- Build the annual operating budget and monthly forecasts for three hospital service lines
- Prepare variance analysis for the CFO and present it at monthly business reviews
- Maintain driver-based models in Adaptive Insights and Excel

Requirements
- 4+ years in FP&A, preferably in healthcare
- Advanced Excel; experience with Adaptive Insights, Anaplan or similar
- CPA or CFA a plus

Compensation: $95,000 to $115,000 base plus an annual bonus.

To apply, send your resume to our recruiting team through the form on our website. Questions? Email the recruiter at jordan.reyes@summitpeakrecruiting.com.
